messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] how to use pi()?
parts:
I just pushed the patch (and test),
so pi() and the other constants should
work now.

It was my fault for not understanding the
base case of the sequence w. separator
rules in the parser which don't include the empty
sequence (which seems like a bad design choice
on Boost's part, but easy enough to patch up
on our end).

- Bob
